title: Govt. proposes extending judges’ retirement age to clear case backlog
summary:
Cabinet Spokesperson Minister Dr Nalinda Jayatissa stated the government’s decision to increase judges’ retirement age aims to expedite pending court cases.



He noted the proposal includes judicial officers such as Supreme Court judges, the Chief Justice and magistrates.

title: Sri Lanka’s inflation rises to 6.5% in June
summary:
Sri Lanka’s overall inflation rate increased to 6.5% in June 2026, up from 5.4% in May, according to the Department of Census and Statistics.



The Department stated food inflation rose to 3.3% in June from 1.5% in May.
